events_seen: WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 25 (yesterday)): Mitchum added Mason Rudolph (QB, PIT) for $5 FAAB (dropped Jaydn Ott (RB, KC)).
CUT (Nov 25 (yesterday)): Charles released Jimmy Garoppolo (QB, FA).
TRADE (Nov 24 (2 days ago)): Adam receives 2027 R4 pick. Charles receives Tommy DeVito (QB, NE).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 22 (4 days ago)): Adam added Phil Mafah (RB, NYG) (dropped Charlie Kolar (TE, LAC)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 22 (4 days ago)): Mitchum added Jaydn Ott (RB, KC) (dropped Sean Tucker (RB, TB)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 22 (4 days ago)): Drew added Josh Johnson (QB, ARI) (dropped Tyler Goodson (RB, DAL)).
CUT (Nov 20 (6 days ago)): Mitchum released Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF).
CUT (Nov 19 (7 days ago)): Fronge released Brevyn Spann-Ford (TE, DAL).

WEEK 11 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Adam, 121.2-120.3 (NAIL-BITER); Jake def. Drew, 124.3-74.1 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Kevin, 115.1-87.5; Charles def. Shaq, 168.2-74.1 (BLOWOUT); Wingard def. Mitchum, 160.1-103.0 (BLOWOUT); Ryan def. Brent, 143.1-72.5 (BLOWOUT)

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Charles cut Jimmy Garoppolo yesterday and acquired Tommy DeVito two days before that. The CROWN quarterback room has been quietly restructured in a seventy-two-hour window while everyone was focused on the 17-5 record. That is a desk doing offseason-style maintenance at Week 12 of a championship-or-bust season. The board will price that in eventually.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: TERRENCE IS AT 5-7 AND FADING WINGARD AGAIN. The man who missed a fifty-three-point blowout has now found a new team to misread in the same matchup. The pick-em ledger is public. The records are sacred. Someone needs to stage an intervention before Week 13.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Ledger will be in your inbox before Week 12 kicks off and I will say this much now — the Corbishley-Adam nail-biter has a footnote that the final score does not capture. APEX nearly dropped a game to the second-worst record in the league on the same week the dynasty board graded their backfield twelfth. Matteo's ranking held. The numbers are going to have something to say about that.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4 on the season and locks 2-0, and I want the segment on Charles vs Ryan before we get buried in Thanksgiving takes. That matchup is not a coronation. It is a pressure test. CROWN at $158.59 and the board measuring stick. AEGIS at $124.14, defending the title from the six seed, and the exchange already gave him +52.6% in July. Someone earns their number this week and I want time to explain which way it falls.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: For anyone expecting my power rankings to move Corbishley back to two after a 121-120 nail-biter against Adam: they will not. One point over a 7-15 roster is not a performance that earns you back ground on the contender board. The receiving corps is still first in the league and the backfield is still twelfth. Those facts do not change because the final margin was narrow.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Ryan beat Brent 143.1-72.5 last week and the narrative machine immediately went back to sleep on Aegis. The defending champion is 11-11, sitting sixth, and just blew someone out by seventy points. At $124.14 on the exchange and a matchup against the 17-5 regular-season king this week, the market is about to find out whether that surge to $124 was price discovery or wishful thinking.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Called Kevin fragile two weeks ago, Fronge beat him by nearly thirty out of Havana, and now Redline faces Brent in Week 12 with the QB room degraded and the dynasty grade dead last in the league by twenty-eight points. I called it going in. I am calling it now: 15-7 is a number that is hiding something very ugly and Brent's desk is not the opponent you want when you are already leaking.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: I am aware of my record. I am aware that I had Mitchum against Wingard. What I will not do is let one bad week rewrite the entire analytical framework — Wingard's production discount is structural and Adam's desk has had more movement in the last seven days than most rosters see in a month. I am standing on the Adam pick and the numbers will bear it out.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Wingard put up 160 last week and the matchup this week is Adam at 7-15. I went 1-1 on locks last week and I am not about to overthink my way out of a gift. Sovereign Draft Reserve covers this by thirty and anyone fading it owns that choice.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Charles put up 168.2 against Shaq last week. Shaq scored 74.1. That is not a football game, that is an audit. The WR wealth at Monarch is real and it has never once covered the RB hole, and 10-12 entering a second straight window without fixing it is the definition of a desk that has accepted its own ceiling.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: TRANSACTION: Mitchum (Deepwater, DEEP) claimed Mason Rudolph off waivers for $5 FAAB, dropping Jaydn Ott — who was added just three days prior. That is a quarterback add before Week 12 against an 0-22 roster, which tells you exactly how concerned the DEEP desk is about its own signal-caller situation heading into the playoff stretch.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Happy Thanksgiving from the LIV Network desk. Drew is 0-22. Atlas Rebuild Works is listed at $28.15. Josh Johnson is now their starting quarterback. There is nothing to be thankful for in that building, but we appreciate the reminder of how far a roster can fall.
